# P35.45 — Dossiers at every level and the unplaced report

**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/324_P35.45__dossiers-at-every-level-unplaced-report.md`
(manifest row **324**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; ticket catalog
`R11-K13-JUR-03`). Invoked `live_verification=false` — exporter code,
emitted artifacts and tests only; **no production mutation, no spine
write, no source flip, no gate tick, no merge to main, no outside
contact**. Requirement stamps: served **SIG-UI-048** (the dossier index
enumerates this row's dossier set with honest absence), **SIG-UI-010…015**
(the dossier content contract rendered at every level), **SIG-UI-044**
(the dossier provenance module reads `provenance_summary`); cited:
**D-K4-3** (the operator's verbatim threshold answer — applied, never
re-decided), **D-K4-4** (Puerto Rico + US territories as US
state-equivalents under `iso3166-1:US`), **D-K4-7** (the conservative
publication profile for adapter-less countries), **K4 `placement@1`**,
**SIG-ONTO-011** (the append-only key-history rule),
**K4 NEW-4/NEW-6** (the DBRight re-review list, and this row landing
before ACT-24). No §56 `Owner:` names this row. **Base:**
`r11/P35.44-dossier-contribution-export` · **Gate:** D-K4-3 [B-44]
carried verbatim.

## The problem

Every publishable jurisdiction needed a dossier at every level —
country, admin-1, US county, US place — not the flat set P35.19-era
emission produced; and every record whose placement chain is absent
needed an honest report instead of a guessed home or a legacy
`unresolved/` tree path. The recorded `placement@1` chain is the
authoritative ancestry input; dossier grouping must never re-derive it.

## What landed

- **`exports/src/exports/dossier_keys.py`** (new, pure) — the canonical
  key registry: `keyed_registry` over the verified boundary pack +
  `placement@1` output, K4 §3.1 nested slug paths (`usa`,
  `usa/ca`, `usa/ca/verdin-county-06037`, `fra` with D-K4-6 alpha-3
  country segments), `group_by_key(row) → (placed keys, declared keys,
  leaf key)` — a placed record belongs to every key on its recorded
  chain exactly once; a chainless record belongs to `unplaced` only.
  `page_basis`/`page_keys` carry the D-K4-3 thresholds verbatim as
  recorded reason strings (every US county ≥1; US places ≥10 or any
  non-site evidence; every US state-equivalent incl. PR/VI under
  `iso3166-1:US`; non-US admin-1 ≥10; every country ≥1) — each emitted
  page names the basis that minted it.
- **`exports/spine_export.py`** — emits one `sig.dossier/2` document per
  dossier at `web/dossiers/<slug-path>.json` (the ~5.6k-dossier
  monolith dies), `sig.dossier-index/2` at `web/dossiers/index.json`,
  `sig.jurisdiction-key-map/1`, append-only
  `sig.jurisdiction-slug-history/1` (`moved`/`corrected`/`split` rows
  preserve every old flat slug and the legacy `unresolved` path),
  `sig.unplaced-report/1` at `web/unplaced.json` (totals, the verbatim
  honest header, closed-vocabulary `by_reason` + `reason_rows` with
  "what would fix it", per-source `by_source`, `correction` links,
  `excluded_from` disclosures, honest `not_emitted` download slots,
  release + boundary-pack + placement-ruleset metadata), the
  `sig.dbright-rereview/1` list (US-located records published under
  the non-US database-right basis — a list for E4, not a rights
  change), gap `subject_id` re-key to `jurisdiction:<jkey>` where the
  key-map is unambiguous (ambiguous split/corrected mappings are
  recorded unchanged, never silently re-homed), `jurisdictionCode`
  alpha-2 on every dossier + index row (conservative profile for
  adapter-less countries per D-K4-7), and a measured dossier build
  (wall time, peak RSS, page count, registry-key count, unplaced
  count) alongside the existing release `measure_build`.
- **`exports/dossier_sources.py`** — one accumulation produces the
  keyed dossier docs and the `sig.dossier-sources/1` mirrors under the
  same slug paths: placed ancestor memberships, leaf-only counts (the
  K4 §5.3 conservation partition — a placed record ends at exactly one
  leaf), point-located counts, and both disagreement legs
  (`declared_here_located_elsewhere` / `located_here_declared_elsewhere`)
  on both sides.
- **`exports/release.py` + `release_pages.py` + `published_record.py`**
  — release record lists group under `jurisdiction/<slug-path>/<page>/`;
  chainless records land at `jurisdiction/unplaced/` (never the legacy
  `unresolved/`); dossier HTML at `r/<pub>/dossier/<slug-path>/` +
  `r/<pub>/dossier/unplaced/`; keyed per-dossier artifacts are read
  when present with a documented fallback to pre-P35.45 monoliths;
  record `jurisdiction` blocks resolve through
  `jurisdiction_key_map.json`.
- **`web/`** — the dossier routes move to catch-all canonical paths
  (`dossier/[...path].astro`, `[...path].json.ts`,
  `[...path]/print.astro`): ancestor breadcrumbs, child-dossier
  roll-ups with threshold named absences (a sub-threshold place is
  listed with its count, deep-linking to the map), disagreement and
  conservation disclosures, `dossierDisplayTitle` name-first titles.
  `/dossier/unplaced/` renders the report (UP-01…08 copy rows) with
  every material numeral a registered `<Figure>` against
  `web/unplaced.json`; its JSON twin serves `/dossier/unplaced.json`.
  Slug-history stubs resolve legacy slugs — `moved`/`corrected` emit
  301-style documents, `split` emits a 300-style choice list. `data.ts`
  reads index v2 + the unbounded per-dossier artifact set
  (`figures.ts`/`check-figures.mjs` `PER_DOSSIER_RE`, index excluded).
  The unplaced report is a sibling of the dossiers — excluded from
  jurisdiction counts, "N jurisdictions" copy and the place facet.
- **Copy batch (append-only)** — route-rebinding rows for
  `/dossier/[slug]/…` → `/dossier/[...path]/…` and the new `UP-*`
  unplaced-report namespace appended; superseded rows keep their
  recorded history via `SUPERSEDED_ROWS` test metadata. Coverage matrix
  cells repointed to the renamed templates.

## Tests

- `tests/exports/test_dossier_keys.py` (new, 13) — registry keying,

- `tests/exports/test_keyed_dossiers.py` (new, 15) — per-dossier JSON

  absence, non-site-evidence pages, `unplaced` never a jurisdiction,
  `jurisdictionCode` + conservative profile, slug-history stubs,
  gap re-keying, the DBRight list, report conservation.
- `tests/exports/test_release.py` (+200 lines) — nested release-tree
  paths, `unplaced/` placement, record `jurisdiction` blocks.
- `tests/exports/test_dossier_sources.py` (+47) — keyed per-dossier
  source artifacts under slug paths.
- `web/tests/unit/data.test.ts` (+245) + `figures.test.ts` (+17) —
  index v2, per-dossier artifacts, the report shape, pointer regexes.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` — catch-all route mappings +
  `UP` ids + superseded-row handling.
